scenes.caption: THE SIGNAL RETURNED
scenes.narration: Every sunrise, a forgotten radio tower flashed once.

scenes.caption: SOMEONE FOLLOWED IT
scenes.narration: A young inventor followed the light into the mist.

scenes.caption: THE STORM ANSWERED
scenes.narration: The pattern matched a rescue signal lost years ago.

scenes.caption: A LIGHT FOR EVERYONE
scenes.narration: She repaired the beacon so nobody would be forgotten again.
